Whether a revoked row takes the access away from the name carried out

revocation_exits.Rd

Decided on 2026-11-12 (item 12, widened): a revoked row the channel carried out revokes the username carried out on the pair carried out, whatever the resolution says now, when the version carried out is certain and the row still names the instance and the project carried out. The account renamed on Entra stays the way it is (option (a) of the 2026-11-10): the owner revokes the old row, which takes the old login off the project, and files a new one, which finds the new name; IT does not touch the instance. Widened to every verdict that names nobody, because a renamed account with an internal contact does not reach TRASPORTO_IDENTITA_CAMBIATA: its contact is the old UPN, which the tenant no longer holds, and the resolution stops on DATO_RECAPITO_INTERNO_INESISTENTE. The same for ambiguous and for a collision nobody answered.

Usage

revocation_exits(executed, current, certain, creating, granted = character())

Arguments

executed

The server, project_id and username carried out, as for pair_change(), or NULL when the row was never carried out.

current

The row as the register holds it, a list or a one-row data frame with server, project_id and request_status.

certain

Whether executed is the version carried out for certain.

creating

Whether the round would create a person for the row.

granted

The usernames the channel carried out on the row while it was active, log_granted_names().

Value

TRUE when the row revokes the username carried out.

Details

Certain means the seal of the channel did not move and the register as read is the version carried out, or log_executed_row() rebuilt it and the seal verified it. On a version the log does not verify the row stays where the rule of the pair puts it, as before.

Outside, decided on 2026-11-12:

  • an instance or a project moved: the gate would judge the rights on the wrong project, and the row stays on DATO_COPPIA_CAMBIATA until the referent brings them back;

  • a person the tenant no longer holds, a row to create: its revocation closes before any instance is asked (pair_change()), and the old login stays for IT to take off by hand, as before;

  • a row carried out for nobody, closed before anybody was resolved;

  • a name the channel never carried out on the row while it was active, log_granted_names(): a request withdrawn before its person was created is sealed under the name the round would have created, a collision's proposal among them, and that name may be somebody else's later (RC1 of the review of unit G, 2026-11-12).
